title: 882. Sum of Subsequence Widths

examples.explanation: Singletons give 0; pairs give 1+1+2 and the triple gives 2.
Sorted contributions of maxima minus minima total 23.

hints: Sort a copy of the array first; the original order does not affect the collection of subsequence value-sets.
In sorted order, the element at index i is the largest in exactly 2^i subsequences and the smallest in exactly 2^(n-1-i) of them.
Precompute powers of two modulo 1000000007 and accumulate a[i] * (2^i - 2^(n-1-i)).
